result.title: Learning Adaptive Defense Strategies: Fine-Tuned LLMs for Network Security Games under Network Mobility
result.summary: Large language models(LLM) show promise for strategic reasoning, yet their ability to compute game-theoretic equilibria under dynamic conditions remains largely unexplored. This work investigates whether fine-tuned LLMs can serve as solver-free surrogates for online equilibrium computation in honeypot allocation, a setting in which network mobility continuously reshapes the underlying attack graph and forces repeated re-solving of a two-player zero-sum game. We construct a dataset of 270 security games on networks of 8--25 nodes with solver-grounded equilibrium labels, and evaluate four classes of predictor over 1{,}524 held-out mobility events: non-learned baselines, six open-weight architectures evaluated zero-shot, the same six after LoRA fine-tuning, and four proprietary models as an external reference point. Predictions are scored without post-hoc repair against exact game-theoretic criteria: exploitability against an optimal attacker best-response, equilibrium support accuracy, and distributional distance. Fine-tuning reduces exploitability across every architecture, and fine-tuned open-weight models of modest size outperform every zero-shot predictor, including proprietary ones; no zero-shot model at any tier reaches the floor set by uniform allocation. Stratifying by mobility type exposes a qualitative shift that aggregate metrics conceal: zero-shot models do not condition on whether a departing node lies on an attack path, while fine-tuned models recover this distinction. We further find that validation loss is negatively rank-correlated with task performance, and that output validity, rather than predictive accuracy, is the binding constraint on further progress.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文考察微调后的 LLM 能否在蜜罐分配这一零和博弈中充当无需求解器的在线均衡预测器：作者构建了 270 个带求解器均衡标签的安全博弈，对六种开源模型做 LoRA 微调，并在 1524 个网络移动事件上以可利用度、均衡支撑准确率和分布距离进行评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 网络移动导致攻击图反复变化、需要重算均衡，这一设定可能为 LVR 中「环境变化后是否重算 latent 状态」提供类比；其「输出有效性而非预测精度是进一步进展的瓶颈」的发现，也可供核查 latent 推理答案可用性与停止决策的评价方式。
